name: Permissions Enhancer
description: Enhance the permissions admin page with collapsible sections and a summary.
project_description:
Trying to determine which permissions a certain role has in Drupal can be a tough task, especially on a larger site. This module simply adds some quality of life improvements to the role permission pages. 

 Features 
 
 Adds a list of active permissions at the top of each role permission page. 
 Adds buttons to show/hide inactive permissions for the role. 
 Adds some extra styling to the permissions table to allow users to scan the table more quickly. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 Once enabled, the module will update the display of any role permissions page. No extra config is needed.
